body.heading: Think of a true thing
paragraphs: Choose a person. Think of something true: You tell the best stories. You always share your crayons.
True compliments feel better than big flattery, because people can believe them.

body.heading: Make and give
paragraphs: Write or dictate the compliment on your card and decorate the other side.
Give it in person if you can. Watching someone read a compliment is half the fun.

takeaway: A true compliment is a tiny gift that costs nothing.
safetyNotes: Compliments should be true and kind; an adult helps deliver them.
screenFreeExtension: Leave a compliment postcard somewhere in the house for someone to find by surprise.
